_help: One schedule of co-located jobs sharing a server's embodied carbon. Each job has `cpu` (cores), `runtime` (how many time-slots it runs), and `start` (which slot it starts). The server is sized for the PEAK of concurrent demand. Edit the schedule and re-run `python tutorial.py`. `budget_kg` is the server's shared embodied carbon in kg; override it with `--budget <kg>`.
